key_findings: All R_s=0 controls reproduce the previously persisted stage-evolution failure locations.
No tested combination with R_s <= 0.25 day completes the full trajectory at all four refinement levels.
R_s=0.50 day completes 1,2,4,8 substeps per event for every tested microrelief amplitude, including D=0.
R_s=1.00 day also completes every refinement for every tested amplitude.
For every D at R_s=0.50 and 1.00 day, state, cumulative top transfer and cumulative bottom transfer contract over both successive chains 1-2 -> 2-4 and 2-4 -> 4-8.

Because D=0 is also repaired, finite hydraulic contact resistance is sufficient for the numerical regularization in this fixture; microrelief is not uniquely responsible, though it remains physically relevant for wetted area and local storage.
